problems.description: Attackers use Ransomware-as-a-Service platforms to launch targeted ransomware attacks on enterprise networks, encrypting critical data and demanding high ransoms. These services lower the technical barrier for attackers, increasing attack frequency.
risk_reduction: Implement robust endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions
Conduct regular employee phishing awareness training

problems.description: Malicious or negligent insiders exploit privilege escalation vulnerabilities to access sensitive data or sabotage systems, bypassing security controls.
risk_reduction: Enforce the principle of least privilege (PoLP)
Conduct continuous monitoring of privileged accounts
Use behavior analytics to detect anomalies

problems.description: Attackers compromise third-party software or hardware vendors to inject malware or backdoors into enterprise environments, making detection difficult until widespread damage occurs.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking
Use code signing and integrity verification

problems.description: Attackers leverage AI tools to craft highly convincing phishing and spear-phishing campaigns, dynamically adapting messages based on real-time information about the target.
risk_reduction: Deploy advanced email filtering with AI detection
Train staff on recognizing sophisticated social engineering

problems.description: Threat actors use encrypted tunnels (e.g., VPNs, Tor, or custom protocols) to stealthily exfiltrate sensitive data, evading traditional data loss prevention (DLP) mechanisms.
risk_reduction: Use network traffic analysis tools with SSL/TLS inspection
Monitor for unusual outbound traffic patterns

problems.description: Organizations using multiple cloud providers suffer from inconsistent security policies and misconfigurations, leading to exposed storage buckets, open APIs, or excessive permissions.
risk_reduction: Use centralized cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers use leaked credentials from breaches to gain unauthorized access to cloud accounts, escalating privileges or deploying malicious workloads.
Threat actors exploit insecure serverless functions to run malicious code, evade detection, or use the cloud provider’s resources for cryptojacking or DDoS attacks.
risk_reduction: Use runtime protection tools specialized for serverless environments

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious code into container images or CI/CD pipelines, which then propagate into production workloads in the cloud.
Employees use unauthorized cloud services or personal accounts to store or share corporate data, bypassing security controls and risking data leakage.
risk_reduction: Deploy cloud access security broker (CASB) solutions
Conduct regular awareness campaigns on shadow IT risks

problems.description: Attackers compromise unsecured IoT devices at the edge to build large botnets used for DDoS attacks or as a pivot into enterprise networks.
Threat actors exploit vulnerabilities in 5G network slicing to intercept, manipulate, or disrupt critical telecom services or data streams.
risk_reduction: Conduct continuous security testing of 5G infrastructure

problems.description: Ransomware targets ICS devices at the edge, disrupting manufacturing or utility operations with significant physical and financial impacts.
risk_reduction: Monitor ICS traffic with anomaly detection

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious code into device firmware during manufacturing or updates, enabling persistent backdoors in edge and telecom devices.
risk_reduction: Validate firmware integrity using cryptographic signatures

problems.description: Mobile devices are targeted with AI-generated phishing messages adapted to user behavior and context, increasing success rates.
risk_reduction: Deploy app reputation and behavior analysis tools

problems.description: Attackers compromise edge devices and use their processing power to mine cryptocurrency, degrading device performance and lifespan.
risk_reduction: Use endpoint protection tailored for edge devices

problems.description: Exploitation of telecom signaling protocols to intercept calls, SMS, or manipulate billing and subscriber data.
Attackers inject poisoned data into AI models deployed on edge devices, causing incorrect outputs or backdoor access.
risk_reduction: Use federated learning with model validation
Monitor model performance and outputs for anomalies

problems.description: Attackers exploit unknown vulnerabilities in NFV components, gaining control over virtualized telecom functions.
Adversaries gain physical access to edge devices, installing hardware implants or modifying components to facilitate long-term compromise.
